single_hypothesis.statement: Retaining already-shown product IDs across ranking-signature changes within the same explicit intent_version epoch will reduce repeated exposure and improve turn utility without losing eligible target hits or rank quality.
changes: bounded intent-epoch validation and deterministic selection
tests, exact oracle, and sealed sequential evaluation harness
does_not_change: starter.Agent before all data gates pass

algorithm.eligible_history: empty when no prior signature or intent epoch changed; otherwise prior shown IDs intersect current pool in prior order
algorithm.unseen: current ranked pool with eligible-history IDs removed, preserving rank order
algorithm.selection: first k unique IDs from unseen concatenated with the complete current ranked pool
algorithm.state_update: unique eligible history concatenated with selected IDs
algorithm.treatment_condition: ranking signature changed and prior/current valid non-negative integer intent epochs are equal
algorithm.complexity: O(pool plus shown) time and O(pool plus shown) transient references

safety_invariant.premise: On an eligible continuation turn, the active target was not accepted in any prior slate from the same intent epoch.
safety_invariant.override_rule: A recognized replacement or override increments intent_version and resets prior shown history exactly.
safety_invariant.claim: For a target absent from eligible prior history, removing prior-history IDs ahead of it can only preserve or improve visible rank, while deterministic backfill preserves slate cardinality.
safety_invariant.scope: conditional on the conversational evaluator contract; empirical hidden-data gates remain mandatory

focused_tests: unit and property tests for intent-epoch slate selection
service integration, reset, cache, fault, and interleaved-session tests
harness schema, accounting, privacy, gate, and one-shot tests

public_confirmation.prerequisite: every development and validation gate passes

per_suite: protected baseline metrics match exactly where frozen
candidate HR@10 is not below baseline
baseline-hit to candidate-miss transitions equal zero
candidate MRR is not below baseline
candidate MTTC is not above baseline
candidate recommended technical score strictly exceeds baseline
candidate MRR or MTTC strictly improves
paired-bootstrap utility-delta lower 95 percent bound is at least zero
candidate replay is exact
independent explicit-policy candidate is exact
all retrieval, ranking, profile, slate, cache, and candidate faults or fallbacks equal zero
candidate slate outcomes partition all candidate slate attempts
one BM25, dense, document, and Stage-A call per fresh search
candidate counted calls do not exceed baseline
model and API token usage remains zero
candidate warm p95 ratio is at most 1.05
candidate total wall-time ratio is at most 1.05
candidate startup-time ratio is at most 1.05
candidate additional startup RSS is at most 1 MiB
candidate additional retained agent state is at most 2 MiB
implementation lock revalidates after all variants
aggregate publication privacy is valid
cross_suite: development and validation pass before public confirmation
point and confidence gates generalize on development and validation
starter remains protected until all three data suites pass

rollback.trigger: Any source, test, oracle, quality, transition, confidence, exactness, call, fault, fallback, token, privacy, performance, memory, or reproducibility gate fails.
rollback.action: Reject the candidate, leave or restore starter.Agent to the protected SHA-256 without destructive git operations, retain the candidate only as inactive research code, append aggregate-only evidence, and do not rerun the consumed suite.
